review_scope: Manually reviewed per-level damage/heal formula derivations, traced against engine C source and skill_db.conf. Not a full skill catalogue -- see docs/plans/encyclopedia-roadmap.md E4 for remaining scope.

entries.title: Heal's Renewal healing formula
entries.review_method: Traced skill_calc_heal's default branch (used by AL_HEAL) under the RENEWAL build flag, including the function's own doc comment restating the formula, and cross-checked the level cap against conf/map/battle/skill.conf.
entries.formula: AL_HEAL (id 28) computes its healed HP via skill_calc_heal (src/map/skill.c), which falls to its default branch (Heal is not one of the specially-cased skills SU_TUNABELLY/BA_APPLEIDUN/PR_SANCTUARY/NPC_EVILLAND). Under RENEWAL that branch computes: hp = floor(floor((BaseLevel + INT) / 5) * 30 * skill_lv / 10), matching the function's own source comment ('(Base Level + INT) / 5, * 30, * (Heal Level / 10)'). Integer division truncates at each step in source order: BaseLevel+INT is divided by 5 first, multiplied by 30, multiplied by skill_lv, then divided by 10.
entries.worked_example: A level-99 caster with 60 INT casting Heal at skill level 10: floor((99+60)/5) = floor(31.8) = 31; 31*30 = 930; 930*10 = 9300; floor(9300/10) = 930 HP, before the HP_MEDITATIO/SU_POWEROFSEA bonuses and skillheal_bonus modifiers applied afterward in the same function.
conditions: If skill_lv is at or above battle_config.max_heal_lv (conf/map/battle/skill.conf: max_heal_lv 11), the function instead returns the flat battle_config.max_heal value (9999) regardless of level/INT; AL_HEAL's own MaxLevel in skill_db.conf is 10, so this cap is only reachable via a level-10-plus bonus from an external source, not a bare cast.

After the base formula, skill_calc_heal applies further additive percentage bonuses (HP_MEDITATIO, homunculus HLIF_BRAIN, SU_POWEROFSEA/SU_TUNABELLY chain, pc->skillheal_bonus/skillheal2_bonus, SC_OFFERTORIUM) that are not derived in this review.

Casting on a mercenary target, or when the heal flag is false (used for undead-race damage instead of healing), the result is halved (hp >>= 1) after the base formula but before those bonus additions; that branch is noted but not separately worked out here.

This is a server-authored value from active source, but effective-config max_heal_lv/max_heal could change with server config; the values cited are the configured defaults checked against conf/map/battle/skill.conf on this revision.

entries.title: Fire/Cold/Lightning Bolt: damage does not scale via skillratio, only via hit count
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_magic_attack's default path for these three skill IDs (base MATK via status->get_matk, then a skillratio multiply through calc_skillratio's BF_MAGIC switch) and confirmed that switch has no case for any of the three, so it falls to a no-op plugin hook that leaves skillratio unchanged at 100. Cross-checked the per-level hit count that instead drives their scaling against skill_db.conf.
entries.formula: MG_FIREBOLT (19), MG_COLDBOLT (14), and MG_LIGHTNINGBOLT (20) all take battle_calc_magic_attack's default branch (src/map/battle.c), which sets ad.damage to the caster's MATK (status->get_matk(src, 2)) then applies card fixes. A nested switch(skill_id) lists these three skill IDs only to handle an unrelated SC_SPELLFIST special case; absent that status, all three fall through to that nested switch's own default, which multiplies by calc_skillratio(BF_MAGIC, ...). calc_skillratio's BF_MAGIC case has no entry for any of the three skill IDs, so it falls to its own default, which calls battle_calc_skillratio_magic_unknown -- an empty function body (a no-op plugin hook) -- leaving skillratio at its unmodified value of 100. So the MATK_RATE multiply is effectively ×100/100 = unchanged. Instead, per-level scaling comes entirely from skill_db.conf's NumberOfHits field for each skill, which is 1:1 with skill level (Lv1=1 hit ... Lv10=10 hits, Hit type BDT_MULTIHIT): the skill fires one MATK-damage hit per level.
entries.worked_example: Fire Bolt at skill level 5 fires 5 hits (NumberOfHits Lv5: 5), each computed as the caster's MATK with no skillratio bonus (still ×100/100), before elemental attribute adjustment (Ele_Fire) and card fixes are applied per hit. This is a materially different scaling mechanism from the flat/level-scaled weapon-skillratio skills reviewed separately: the per-hit multiplier never changes, only the hit count does.
conditions: The caster's MATK value itself (status->get_matk) is a separate, unreviewed formula (INT/DEX/LUK-derived stat and equipment matk).
The SC_SPELLFIST branch (a Spellfist Sage/Scholar combo state) overrides this entirely with a different formula and is not reviewed here.
This review does not establish whether per-hit damage is randomized/varied or identical across the multiple hits of one cast; only that no skillratio bonus is applied to any individual hit.

entries.title: First-job magic attack damage ratios (Napalm Beat, Fire Ball, Frost Diver, Fire Wall, Ruwach, Holy Light)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_magic_attack to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_MAGIC switch in src/map/battle.c.
entries.formula: In src/map/battle.c under BF_MAGIC: MG_NAPALMBEAT (11) adds `skill_lv * 10 - 30` (ratio = 70 + 10*Lv, 80%-170%, with splash damage distribution); MG_FIREBALL (17) under RENEWAL adds `20 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 20*Lv, 120%-300%); MG_FROSTDIVER (15) adds `10 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 10*Lv, 110%-200%); MG_FIREWALL (18) subtracts 50 (`skillratio -= 50`), setting each wall hit to exactly 50% MATK; AL_RUWACH (24) adds 45 (`skillratio += 45`), dealing 145% MATK; AL_HOLYLIGHT (156) adds 25 (`skillratio += 25`, 125% MATK), and if the caster has Priest Soul Link (SC_SOULLINK with SL_PRIEST), the ratio is multiplied by 5 (`skillratio *= 5`, dealing 625% MATK).
entries.worked_example: Fire Ball Lv 10: skillratio = 100 + 20*10 = 300 (300% MATK). Holy Light under Priest Soul Link: skillratio = (100 + 25) * 5 = 625 (625% MATK).
conditions: Holy Light's 5x multiplier requires active status change SC_SOULLINK granted by a Soul Linker targeting a Priest.
Mage/Acolyte base MATK and elemental matchup tables are separate calculation stages.

per_skill.notes: Splash damage drops across multiple targets.
Splash area damage around central target.
Freeze chance evaluated separately in status.c.
Deals 50% MATK per hit and knocks back target.
Reveals hidden enemies and deals 145% MATK.
125% MATK base, 625% MATK under Soul Link.

entries.title: Wizard elemental magic damage ratios (Sightrasher, Water Ball, Storm Gust, Heaven's Drive, Meteor Storm, Lord of Vermilion)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_magic_attack to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_MAGIC switch for Wizard 2nd-job elemental attack spells under RENEWAL.
entries.formula: In src/map/battle.c under BF_MAGIC: WZ_SIGHTRASHER (81) adds `20 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 20*Lv, 120%-300%); WZ_WATERBALL (86) adds `30 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 30*Lv, 130%-400% per sphere hit); WZ_STORMGUST (89) under RENEWAL adds `-30 + 50 * skill_lv` (ratio = 70 + 50*Lv, 120%-570% per hit, freezing targets on third hit); WZ_HEAVENDRIVE (91) under RENEWAL adds a flat 25 (`skillratio += 25`, ratio = 125% MATK per hit); WZ_METEOR (83) under RENEWAL adds a flat 25 (`skillratio += 25`, ratio = 125% MATK per meteor hit); WZ_VERMILION (85) under RENEWAL adds `-100 + 400 + skill_lv * 100` (ratio = 400 + 100*Lv, 500%-1400% distributed over its multi-hit storm waves).
entries.worked_example: Storm Gust Lv 10: skillratio = 100 - 30 + 50*10 = 570 (570% MATK per wave hit). Lord of Vermilion Lv 10: skillratio = 100 - 100 + 400 + 100*10 = 1400 (1400% MATK base total across storm waves).
conditions: Water Ball requires standing on water cells or having Water Deluge active.
Storm Gust freeze status interaction is handled by status.c, which turns the target to Water element and stops further hits once frozen.

per_skill.notes: Requires Ruwach active to cast.
Consumes water cells or Water Deluge.
Pushes back and freezes target after 3 hits.
Hits up to 5 times depending on skill level.
Each falling meteor deals 125% MATK in splash area.
4 waves of 10 hits each.

entries.title: Arrow Shower damage ratio (Renewal)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default path to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON switch and read the RENEWAL branch for AC_SHOWER and MA_SHOWER.
entries.formula: Under RENEWAL (src/map/battle.c), AC_SHOWER (47) and MA_SHOWER (8208) add `50 + 10 * skill_lv` to the baseline skillratio of 100. Thus final skillratio = 150 + 10 * skill_lv, dealing 160% weapon attack damage at level 1 up to 250% at level 10.
entries.worked_example: Arrow Shower Lv 10: skillratio = 100 + 50 + 10*10 = 250 (250% weapon attack damage per target in the area of effect).
conditions: Ground knockback and area splash behavior are handled by skill unit logic outside this damage ratio formula.
Normal weapon attack ATK base, ammo ATK, and defense reduction are separate pipeline stages.

per_skill.notes: Archer skill.
Baby/Doram variant sharing the same formula.

entries.title: Demonstration and Acid Terror damage ratios with Potion Research scaling (Renewal)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default path to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON AM_DEMONSTRATION and AM_ACIDTERROR cases under RENEWAL in src/map/battle.c.
entries.formula: In src/map/battle.c under RENEWAL: AM_DEMONSTRATION (229) adds `-100 + 60 * skill_lv` plus `10 * pc->checkskill(sd, AM_LEARNINGPOTION)`. Combined with baseline 100, final skillratio = `60 * skill_lv + 10 * Potion_Research_Lv`. AM_ACIDTERROR (230) adds `-100 + 200 * skill_lv` plus `100 * pc->checkskill(sd, AM_LEARNINGPOTION)`. Combined with baseline 100, final skillratio = `200 * skill_lv + 100 * Potion_Research_Lv`.
entries.worked_example: Acid Terror Lv 5 with Potion Research Lv 10: skillratio = 200*5 + 100*10 = 1000 + 1000 = 2000% weapon attack damage. Demonstration Lv 5 with Potion Research Lv 10: skillratio = 60*5 + 10*10 = 300 + 100 = 400% weapon attack damage.
conditions: Potion Research (AM_LEARNINGPOTION) bonus is only evaluated when caster is a player character (sd != NULL).
Consumes catalyst items (Bottle Grenade / Acid Bottle) on cast per skill_db.conf/skill.c.

per_skill.notes: Weapon-break chance and ground-trap hit interval handled in skill.c.
Armor-break chance and bleeding status handled in skill.c.

entries.title: Brandish Spear weapon damage ratio and STR scaling (Renewal)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default path to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON KN_BRANDISHSPEAR case in src/map/battle.c under RENEWAL.
entries.formula: Under RENEWAL in src/map/battle.c, KN_BRANDISHSPEAR (57) evaluates: `skillratio += 300 + 100 * skill_lv + status_get_str(src) * 5`. Combined with baseline skillratio of 100, final ratio = 400 + 100 * skill_lv + 5 * STR. Damage scales with both skill level and the caster's current total STR stat.
entries.worked_example: A Knight with 80 total STR casting Brandish Spear Lv 10: skillratio = 100 + 300 + 100*10 + 5*80 = 400 + 1000 + 400 = 1800% of normal weapon attack damage.
conditions: Brandish Spear requires a spear weapon and riding a Peco Peco.
Area shape and knockback are handled by skill_unit logic; this entry reviews the damage multiplier.

entries.title: Standard weapon-skill damage ratio (battle_calc_weapon_attack default path)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default control path (base ATK via GET_NORMAL_ATTACK, then a skillratio multiply via battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON switch) and read each named skill's literal skillratio expression from that switch.
entries.formula: For these skills battle_calc_weapon_attack (src/map/battle.c) takes the default branch of its main skill_id switch, which sets wd.damage to the character's normal weapon attack via GET_NORMAL_ATTACK (battle->calc_base_damage, RENEWAL mode). A second, separate switch(skill_id) then also falls to its own default, which does `wd.damage = wd.damage * calc_skillratio(BF_WEAPON, ...) / 100` (the ATK_RATE macro). calc_skillratio starts an internal `skillratio` at 100 (passed in from the caller, already 100 at this point) and, inside its `case BF_WEAPON:` switch, adds a skill-specific bonus to it before returning. So final ratio = 100 + skill-specific bonus, applied as a straight percentage multiplier on the normal-attack damage that was already computed. Defense reduction, card modifiers, and elemental adjustment are later, skill-independent pipeline stages not re-derived here.
entries.worked_example: SM_BASH at skill level 10 against a target with no special resistances: skillratio = 100 + 30*10 = 400, i.e. the hit deals 400% of the character's computed normal-attack damage (that normal-attack ATK value is a separate, unreviewed formula) before defense/card/element adjustment.
conditions: This entry covers only the skillratio percentage multiplier. The base normal-attack ATK value it multiplies (weapon ATK, STR/DEX/LUK contributions, refine, size penalty, MAXIMIZEPOWER/WEAPONPERFECT flags via GET_NORMAL_ATTACK) is a separate formula not re-derived in this review.
Defense reduction, card fixes, and elemental attribute adjustment happen in later stages of battle_calc_weapon_attack / battle_calc_damage, outside calc_skillratio, and are not covered here.

Several of these skills (Magnum Break's fire field, Spear Stab's stun, Grimtooth's charge consumption, Poison React's trigger condition) have additional non-damage mechanics handled elsewhere in skill.c/status.c that this entry does not review.
AS_SONICBLOW uses the same calc_skillratio(BF_WEAPON, ...) mechanism but has its own conditional (target-HP-dependent) formula and is reviewed separately as weapon_skillratio_sonic_blow_renewal.

Same case label and formula as SM_BASH.
Shared with MS_MAGNUM (id 8202). Magnum Break also lays a ground fire field handled elsewhere; only the direct hit ratio is reviewed here.

Scales with the caster's current STR stat, not skill level; skill_lv is unused in this branch.

Same case label and formula as AC_DOUBLE.

Same case label and formula as AC_CHARGEARROW.

A mercenary skill; source and target are the mercenary unit and its target, not the summoning player.

entries.title: Holy Cross damage ratio and two-handed spear doubling (Renewal)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default path to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON CR_HOLYCROSS case in src/map/battle.c under RENEWAL.
entries.formula: CR_HOLYCROSS (253) calculates ratio = 35 * skill_lv. Under RENEWAL, if the player is wielding a two-handed spear (sd != NULL && sd->weapontype == W_2HSPEAR), ratio is doubled (ratio *= 2). Finally skillratio += ratio. Since baseline skillratio is 100, the ratio is 100 + 35 * skill_lv with standard weapons (135% at Lv1 up to 450% at Lv10), or 100 + 70 * skill_lv with a two-handed spear (170% at Lv1 up to 800% at Lv10). The skill hits 2 times (NumberOfHits: 2 in skill_db.conf).
entries.worked_example: Holy Cross Lv 10 with a One-Handed Sword: ratio = 35*10 = 350; skillratio = 100 + 350 = 450%. With a Two-Handed Spear: ratio = (35*10)*2 = 700; skillratio = 100 + 700 = 800%.
conditions: The 2x bonus ratio is conditional on equipping a Two-Handed Spear (W_2HSPEAR).
Holy Cross has Holy element forced by skill_db.conf and a chance to inflict Blind, handled in status/battle calculation.

entries.title: Sand Attack and Cart Revolution damage ratios
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default path to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON switch for TF_SPRINKLESAND and MC_CARTREVOLUTION, including cart-weight scaling logic.
entries.formula: In src/map/battle.c, TF_SPRINKLESAND (149) adds a flat +30 to skillratio (final ratio 130% of normal weapon attack). MC_CARTREVOLUTION (153) adds a base +50, and if the player character has a cart with weight, adds `100 * cart_weight / cart_weight_max` (i.e. +1% ratio per 1% of max cart weight used, reaching +100% at 100% capacity for a total ratio of 250%). Non-player casters unconditionally receive the full +100% cart weight bonus.
entries.worked_example: Cart Revolution with a cart loaded to 8,000 / 8,000 weight (100% full): skillratio = 100 + 50 + 100 = 250 (250% weapon attack damage). With an empty cart (0 weight): skillratio = 100 + 50 = 150 (150% weapon attack damage).
conditions: Cart Revolution damage depends dynamically on current cart weight relative to max cart weight at the moment of calculation.
Sand Attack's elemental attribute and blind status chance are handled in status/skill logic outside this ratio.

per_skill.notes: Blind chance is evaluated separately in status.c.
Knockback and splash targets handled separately.

entries.title: Second-job physical skill damage ratios (Shield Charge, Intimidate, Triple Attack, Musical Strike, Throw Arrow, Venom Splasher)
entries.review_method: Traced battle_calc_weapon_attack's default path to battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON switch for Crusader, Rogue, Monk, Bard/Dancer, and Assassin second-job physical skills.
entries.formula: In src/map/battle.c under BF_WEAPON: CR_SHIELDCHARGE (250) adds `20 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 20*Lv, 120%-200%); RG_INTIMIDATE (219) adds `30 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 30*Lv, 130%-250%); MO_TRIPLEATTACK (263) adds `20 * skill_lv` (ratio = 100 + 20*Lv, 120%-300%, triggering a 3-hit animation); BA_MUSICALSTRIKE (316) and DC_THROWARROW (324) under RENEWAL add `10 + 40 * skill_lv` (ratio = 110 + 40*Lv, 150%-310%); AS_SPLASHER (141) under RENEWAL adds `-100 + 400 + 100 * skill_lv` (ratio = 400 + 100*Lv, 500%-1400% on delayed detonation).
entries.worked_example: Musical Strike Lv 5: skillratio = 100 + 10 + 40*5 = 310 (310% weapon attack damage). Venom Splasher Lv 10: skillratio = 100 - 100 + 400 + 100*10 = 1400 (1400% weapon attack damage).
conditions: Triple Attack's proc chance on auto-attack is separate from this damage ratio formula.
Venom Splasher requires target HP threshold and poison status to plant, which are skill.c prerequisites.

per_skill.notes: Requires shield; knockback/stun handled in skill.c.
Random teleportation of caster and target handled in skill.c.
Passive trigger chance defined in skill_db.conf; fires 3 hits.
Instrument weapon skill.
Whip weapon skill.
Delayed explosion damage ratio upon target reaching detonation timer.

entries.title: Sonic Blow's target-HP-conditional damage ratio (Renewal)
entries.review_method: Traced the same battle_calc_weapon_attack default path as the standard weapon-skillratio entry, then read Sonic Blow's own RENEWAL-gated case in battle_calc_skillratio, including its target-HP conditional bonus.
entries.formula: AS_SONICBLOW (id 136) has its own case in battle_calc_skillratio's BF_WEAPON switch (src/map/battle.c). Under RENEWAL: let ratio = 200 + 100*skill_lv - 100; the function adds (ratio - 100) to skillratio, and if the target's current HP is less than half its max HP, it adds a further (ratio / 2). Combined with the starting skillratio of 100, the total multiplier is 100 + (ratio-100) [+ ratio/2 if target HP < 50%]. The pre-RENEWAL branch (skillratio += 300 + 40*skill_lv, compiled out under #ifdef RENEWAL) is not applicable on this server, which runs in RENEWAL mode.
entries.worked_example: Sonic Blow at skill level 10 against a target above half HP: ratio = 200 + 100*10 - 100 = 1100; skillratio = 100 + (1100-100) = 1100, i.e. 1100% of normal-attack damage. Against the same target below half HP: skillratio = 1100 + 1100/2 = 1650, i.e. 1650% of normal-attack damage.
conditions: As with the standard weapon-skillratio entry, this covers only the percentage multiplier; the base normal-attack ATK, defense reduction, card fixes, and elemental adjustment are separate, unreviewed stages.
The target-HP check is evaluated at the moment damage is calculated, using status_get_hp/status_get_max_hp; it is a hit-time condition, not a cast-time one.
